observations: Organization is unique per tenant (uk_organizations_tenant, V33), so Academics.organizations is always 0 or 1.
Cache key includes windowDays although the 12-month series does not depend on it: three keys per tenant instead of one (harmless fragmentation).

@PreAuthorize/JWT are exercised by wrapping the real controller in the real method-security proxy with a real JwtAuthenticationToken; the 401 for a missing token belongs to the filter chain and is not covered at this layer.

The Postgres seed was first unrealistic (tenants physically contiguous, created_at scattered): the planner then preferred pre-existing idx_sessions_tenant for two session queries and the test failed. The seed was made realistic (interleaved tenants, time columns follow insertion order, VACUUM ANALYZE); the assertions were not changed.
